coverage_boundary: The 17,374 source-discovered translatable leaves exclude 34 unrendered ending condition notes from the initial 17,408. This is not a complete runtime-exposure claim. The six foreshadows now have a source-bound built-in-overlay validator contract; this does not fill missing translations, prove StoryMode display, or support external language packs. The two public-demo foreshadows remain outside the current write scope. Global UI candidates (329) still cannot be imported. Relationship display names (21 occurrences, 14 unique Korean names) remain outside this leaf denominator. Diagnostic counts are not additive translation counts. Full-game claims require resolved consumers and separate rendered/native review.
authorship: Each locale independently authored from Korean. No English pivot or Simplified/Traditional conversion.
acceptance_boundary: Accepted records attest exact Korean-source comparison and machine checks, not native or human play approval. Existing target rows without records are not presumed fresh.
